decisions.reason: A chair family close to the core offer serves both residential and contract customers and is a lasting part of the range, even though it has not been visible online recently.
Carpet floor cushions are a low-cost niche accessory that uses rug materials, but their absence from the website since 2020 points to a real risk of pruning.
The high standing table fits the flexible workplace and lounge direction and is cheap to keep, though it has not been visible since 2020.
The rug collection was presented as a flagship of the firm's direction, so management likely keeps supporting it despite its distance from the core and the gap in web visibility.
